title: Contact
intro: A question, a voice to suggest, a bug to report? Write to us, the message lands straight on our Discord.
name: Name or nickname
err: Name: 2 characters minimum. Message: 10 characters minimum.
ok: Message sent, thanks! We reply on Discord.
fail: Send failed. Retry or come to the Discord server.
hint: No account needed, no tracking: only your message transits, and your email is used solely to reply.
